title: Pass HV: Haiku 5.5 on inputs v1, unit packets only
question: How does Haiku annotate with inputs v1?
method: Fresh subagent; packet-only inputs v1 over T1, T2, T3, T4, U5–U12 and held-out H1–H6; validated with rule warnings; first versions kept.
commands: S0_SAMPLE=results/s0r2/sample.json UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0_check.py results/s0r2/pass_hv --rules --out results/s0r2/stored/pass_hv

agents.separation: fresh subagent; read only its input folder and output folder (transcript audit of every file opened, 2026-10-28); wrote validator output and a quote-check script (reading only its packets and batches) to temporary files outside its folders, then deleted them

conclusion: Eighteen valid batches with no rule warnings; four units needed repairs (a JSON brace, LaTeX spacing copied inexactly, a missing scope qualifier, a quote).
